triggers.name: scheduled_query
triggers.title: Scheduled record search
triggers.description: Scheduled record search using query in ServiceNow secondary
triggers.help: Execute query on specified schedule. Query results will be returned in batches of records. Maximum batch size is 2000 .

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only base tables are available in the pick list. Toggle to Enter table name if the table you are looking for is not found.

input.name: sysparm_query
input.label: Query
input.hint: ServiceNow query to filter the records you want. Example: active=true^stateIN1,3 .

input.name: hour
input.label: Hour
input.hint: Hours in 24-hour format, i.e. 11 for 11am, 23 for 11pm. Defaults to 00 (12am) if left empty.

input.name: minute
input.label: Minute
input.hint: Minutes past the hour, i.e 00 for 0 minutes.

input.name: day_of_month
input.label: Day of month
input.hint: 1 - 31 , will be rounded down to last day of month for shorter months. Defaults to first day of the month if left empty.

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Maximum number of records per trigger event. Minimum is 1 and maximum is 2000. Default is 2000.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own ServiceNow action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your ServiceNow connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.hint: File contents will be transferred in chunks of this size. Enter the size with the unit, Eg. 50KB. Valid units are 'B', 'KB', 'MB'. Default chunk size is 10MB . Minimum is 32KB and maximum is 10MB . Us…

actions.name: search_objects_v2
actions.title: Search records
actions.description: Search for records in a table in ServiceNow secondary
actions.help: Search for records in a selected table that match all your search criteria. First select the table, then provide the values for each column to match. Search result list is limited to 100 records. Use the Search result size field to increase the limit up to 50000 . If the request takes too long and t…

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only base tables are available in the pick list. Toggle to Enter table name if the table you are looking for is not found.

input.name: datetime_operator
input.label: Datetime operator
input.hint: Operator that acts on all fields of datetime type, e.g. search will return records where datetime field >= input field value. Defaults to >=.

input.name: count
input.label: Search result size
input.hint: Total matched records to be returned. Maximum accepted value is 50000.

input.name: offset
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Starting position from which records should be fetched. Use this value to paginate record retrieval. Default is 0 .
